name: nametag
description: Marks an idle session's name in up to three steps (💤, 💤💤, 💤💤💤) and clears the mark at the next turn

level1_minutes.title: Level 1: idle minutes
level1_minutes.description: Minutes with no prompt or turn before the first emoji is added

level1_emoji.title: Level 1: emoji
level1_emoji.description: The first emoji in the mark; empty turns this level off

level2_minutes.title: Level 2: idle minutes
level2_minutes.description: Minutes with no prompt or turn before the second emoji is added

level2_emoji.title: Level 2: emoji
level2_emoji.description: The second emoji in the mark; empty turns this level off

level3_minutes.title: Level 3: idle minutes
level3_minutes.description: Minutes with no prompt or turn before the third emoji is added

level3_emoji.title: Level 3: emoji
level3_emoji.description: The third emoji in the mark; empty turns this level off

position.title: Mark position
position.description: Put the mark before the name (start) or after it (end)

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Text between the mark and the name, with a space on each side (for example -); empty for just a space

brackets.title: Brackets
brackets.description: Wrap the mark's emojis in brackets
